decisions.reason: Optical spectrum connectivity draws directly on the firm's fibre, network engineering and software-defined infrastructure capabilities, so absorptive capacity is high and management would be unlikely to withdraw it.
The voice number ordering portal reuses existing voice, provisioning and automation know-how and supports the shift to real-time digital service operations, making retention more likely than exit.

Carrier pre-selection is a legacy telephony offer with limited strategic fit to the firm's move toward integrated high-bandwidth cloud-oriented services, so management would likely redeploy resources away from it despite having the capability to run it.

Direct voice network connection remains close to the enterprise communications base and can be delivered through current infrastructure and support teams, so it is likely to be kept while demand is monitored.
